title: Favourite ladder with take-profit (paper research, Dublin box)
brief: Dublin brief 2026-11-26 (operator's idea: side model -> maker buy ladder -> per-rung maker take-profit)

data.source: ~/shadow-rec pm (UP top of book), tr (prints), bn (Binance aggTrade); winners from Gamma via pmlat.winners
data.day_of_window: UTC date of the window start

sim.engine: lt1_sim.py: C port of dsim_strict.maker_strict (lt1_maker.c), checked for exact equality with the Python function on real orders before use
sim.scenario: live (f9_live): book seen +9 ms; post on book +55 ms if BTC best bid/ask unchanged over the prior 1 s else +190 ms; cancel lands signal +90 ms and never before on-book +90 ms (ackc); taker hold 150 ms
sim.fills: strict (through-prints fill at most print size minus queue ahead)
sim.own_order_print_sharing: within one ladder world (market, window, token, step, offset, pull) rungs are simulated shallow-first and a print's size consumed by an earlier rung is not available to later rungs; the TPs of one world and one x share prints the same way, processed in rung order then fill time

side_models.note: all inputs strictly before window open (Binance spot local receive time < window start; winners of windows that closed at or before window start)
side_models.R: seeded random side: numpy default_rng(hash of (20261126, tf, epoch)) -> UP/DOWN
side_models.S2: previous two windows same winner -> that side, else skip
side_models.M15: sign of Binance spot BTC last trade price before open minus last trade price before open-15 min (0 -> skip)
side_models.EMA: sign of (last completed 1m close before open - EMA20 of 1m closes), 1m closes = last spot trade in each minute; needs >= 40 minutes of history (else skip)
side_models.BOTH: ladder on both tokens (pair control; no mirror)
side_models.mirror: every model except BOTH also evaluated on the opposite side (suffix _mir)

ladder.post: once at window open: decision at window start + 1000 ms, anchor = chosen token's best bid in the book seen at that time (rows up to t - 9 ms); all rungs sent at the decision; never re-posted

pull.b2_250: Binance USD-M BTC trade with price >= 2 bp against the side vs the last USD-M trade at or before (trade time - 250 ms)
pull.against: UP ladder: BTC falls; DOWN ladder: BTC rises
pull.timing: first such event received (box local receive ms) after the decision; all unfilled rungs cancelled, cancel lands receive + 90 ms (and >= on-book + 90); fills before it lands count; no re-post

ladder.end: all unfilled rungs cancelled at 60 s left (lands +90 ms)

take_profit.trigger: each fill event of a rung gets its own maker sell of that fill's size
take_profit.decision: fill time + 9 ms; arrival by live post latency
take_profit.price: min(fill + x, 99c); if the seen book's best bid of the token is already >= that price, the sell is placed at the seen best ask instead (post-only cannot cross); if still rejected on arrival, retried at arrival + 9 ms, at most 3 tries, else no TP
take_profit.queue: same fill model (a sell of token T at p is simulated as a buy of the other token at 1-p in UP terms)
take_profit.min_size: Polymarket's 5-share minimum is not enforced for TPs of partial fills (deviation, optimistic)

exits.E1: TP rests until the window close; shares not sold settle at 1/0 (Gamma winner)
exits.E2: TP cancelled at 30 s left (lands +90 ms); remaining shares sold by taker FAK at 30 s left (match = t + post latency + 150 ms hold) into the token's best bid, size capped at the shown size; census fee for that window (fees_by_window.csv fee_rate; fallback 0.07 before 2026-11-21 00:03 UTC, 0.05 after) x p(1-p) per share; any unsold remainder settles

grid: 2 markets x 3 steps x 3 K x 2 offsets x 4 TP x 3 pulls x 2 exits = 864 configs

metrics.unit: filled rung = a rung with >= 1 fill; c/share = sum P&L / sum filled shares; $/day at 5 shares/rung
per_cell: markouts 1/5/30 s (mid of token at fill + h minus fill)
90% CI by window bootstrap (2000 resamples, seed 0)
metrics.model_value: per config and market: model minus mirror c/share with a 90% window-bootstrap CI (paired by window)
metrics.mechanism: markout 1/5/30 s by pull and rung depth (pess)

validation.V0: C maker equals dsim_strict.maker_strict (pess and prop) on >= 2000 real orders of one dev day: identical fill times and sizes
validation.V1: synthetic martingale book: for every x, |EV - (fill markout to settlement-consistent mid + measured exit spread capture)| <= 0.1c, and x=1 TP hit rate >= 70%; i.e. the TP adds no EV beyond spread capture
validation.V2: synthetic book with planted mean reversion after drops: ladder EV > 0 with 90% CI low > 0
validation.V3: dev, pull none, K=1, offset 0, pess: rung 1 s markout within noise of -1.1..-1.4c (prior join-maker, D5); if not, explain before going on

stop_rule: if no dev cell (pess) has 30 s markout + 0.5c > 0, write LT1 closed and skip the holdout
dev_pick: highest dev 90% CI lower bound of c/share among (model incl. mirrors and BOTH, config, market) cells with >= 30 filled rungs/day under pess; written to frozen/LT1_pick.json with code commit and pushed before any holdout day is opened
holdout_pass: frozen pick on 2026-11-25..12-01 under pess: net >= +1.0c/share per filled rung, 90% CI low > 0, >= 200 filled rungs, positive on >= 5 of 7 days; prop reported beside; whole-grid holdout distribution reported as context only
